greenLineCheck.note: Approximate hand-drawn outlines (±1–2 km); footprints near the line can be misassigned. Use with the probes.
greenLineCheck.interpretation: Probe boxes beyond the Green Line (East Jerusalem neighbourhoods, WB settlements and their industrial zones, WB Palestinian cities, Golan, Gaza) are empty except the Old City/Sheikh Jarrah box, whose few footprints are the Mount Scopus enclave edge (easternmost centroid ≈35.243E) — the pre-1967 Israeli enclave on Mount Scopus IS populated, while all controls are populated too; the index lists WestBank, GazaStrip, GolanHeights and GolanHeightsSubdistrict as separate Locations. The non-zero byApproxRegion westBank/golan/gaza counts are Israeli towns along the line (Modiin, Rosh HaAyin/Kafr Qasim, Taibe/Tira, Umm al-Fahm/Wadi Ara, Gilboa, Jerusalem corridor, Hula/Dan, Nahal Oz/Eshkol) caught by the coarse outline — see outlineHitsTopCells. Conclusion: Location "Israel" = the 1949 armistice lines (incl. the Mount Scopus enclave), excluding East Jerusalem, the West Bank, the Golan Heights and Gaza.
